votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes from December 13, 2022 and January 10, 2023.
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes from its two prior meetings in December 2022 and January 2023.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 01 of 2023, approving the fourth amendment to the operating agreement for the Utah Performing Arts Center and Resolution 02 of 2023, approving the second amendment to the interlocal cooperation agreement (Utah Performing Arts Center).
votes.description: The Board adopted two resolutions amending interlocal agreements between Salt Lake City, the RDA, and the Utah Performing Arts Center Agency (UPACA) for the Eccles Theater, addressing cost increases and ongoing maintenance funding.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent agenda (setting the date of Tuesday, March 14, 2023 at 2 p.m. to accept public comment about a resolution amending the 20-year consolidated budget for the State Street Community Reinvestment Area).
votes.description: The Board set a public hearing date of March 14, 2023 to receive comment on a proposed budget amendment for the State Street CRA, aligning the budget with executed interlocal agreements with participating taxing entities.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, sale or lease of real property and attorney-client matters.
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed session to discuss real property transactions and privileged attorney-client matters pursuant to the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
The Board voted to conclude the closed session and return to open session.
